title: Restriction of the scalar Chern arrow
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of the l-adic rationals, a scheme T, Chern data c whose scalarUnit satisfies unitNormalization [def-sp-tower-class-chern, def-sp-tower-class-reduction], and an arbitrary integral degree-two arrow f from its coefficient single to its root single, the single of scalarGenerator followed by mapSingleArrow of restriction applied to scalarChernArrow [def-sfb-scalar-chern-arrow] equals f followed by the shifted single of the ordinary scalar unit on the root module.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: The uniqueness of the supplied scalar adjunction identifies it with the canonical adjunction that defines scalarShift. Consequently its unit is shift-compatible.
Take the source equation from the hypothesis unitNormalization and the target equation from scalarRootTranspose. Apply normalizedScalarArrow_transpose at degree two.

theorem scalarArrowTranspose (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (hc : unitNormalization c.scalar.T
      (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coefficientSystemMap l E T))
      c.scalar.adjunction c.scalarUnit (scalarGenerator l E T))
    (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
        c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).map
        (scalarGenerator l E T) ≫
      mapSingleArrow (SemilinearSections.res (coefficientSystemMap l E T)) (2 : ℤ)
        (scalarChernArrow l E c f) =
      f ≫ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).map
        (c.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app c.rootModule))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧'
